title: Schedule of Service Charges — Collection Review Charge on Electric Service by Rate Schedule Seasonal Restores
content:
**Charge.** A seasonal restore of an idle Electric Service by Rate Schedule account adds a collection review charge to the restore fee according to the number of late payment charges on the service account dated in the collection review period:

| Late payment charges in the collection review period | Added to the restore fee |
|---|---|
| Two or more | $30.00 |
| Exactly one | $10.00 |
| None | Nothing |

### Hypothetical cases

| Late payment charges in the review period | Charge |
|---|---|
| 0 | Nothing |
| 1 | $10.00 |
| 2 | $30.00 |
| 4 | $30.00 |
